en.headline: Hong Kong seeks more sovereign issuers for dim sum bond market
en.dek: Analysts say the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting offers a chance to attract Asia-Pacific governments to the city’s offshore yuan bond market, where issuance has already reached 266.9 billion yuan this year.
body: Hong Kong is positioning itself to draw more sovereign borrowers into its dim sum bond market as the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting takes place in the city, according to analysts cited by the South China Morning Post.

The South China Morning Post reported that elevated US interest rates have raised the cost of dollar borrowing, making offshore renminbi issuance more attractive for some governments. Marcus Yin, assistant vice-president of the sovereign risk group at Moody’s, said alternative currencies including offshore renminbi offered lower fundraising costs and diversification benefits.

HKEX data showed dim sum bond issuance reached 266.9 billion yuan as of late September, up 13.8 per cent year on year, with outstanding volume close to 1.9 trillion yuan. FTSE Russell put the yield to maturity for dim sum bonds at about 2.01 per cent as of late September, compared with roughly 5.1 per cent for US Treasuries in mid-October.
Finance Secretary Paul Chan has previously highlighted Hong Kong’s role in debt financing for developing economies. APEC members account for about 62 per cent of global GDP.

zh.headline: 港府爭取更多主權發行人進入點心債市場
zh.dek: 分析指APEC財長會議是吸引亞太政府發債的機會，今年點心債發行量已達2669億元人民幣。
body: 香港正把握APEC財長會議在港舉行的時機，爭取更多主權發行人進入點心債市場，《南華早報》引述分析指出。
《南華早報》報道，美國利率偏高推高美元借貸成本，令部分政府更傾向離岸人民幣發行。穆迪主權風險組助理副總裁Marcus Yin表示，包括離岸人民幣在內的替代貨幣可提供較低融資成本及分散風險。
港交所數據顯示，截至九月底點心債發行量達2669億元人民幣，按年增13.8%，未償還餘額近1.9萬億元。富時羅素指九月底點心債到期收益率約2.01%，對比十月中美國國債約5.1%。
財政司司長陳茂波早前曾強調香港在發展中經濟體債務融資方面的角色。APEC成員經濟體約佔全球GDP的62%。
